end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Om identified standing and sleeping lines using body-position examples.
They initially questioned whether a tilted slanting line is straight; this was corrected later in the lesson.
They continued to describe V and zigzag shapes as curved because they have corners; this was not corrected by the end.
Unaided responses were correct in 3 of 6 attempts; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines with Om, using body movements and examples such as a leaning letter. Om corrected the mix-up that a tilted slanting line can still be straight. They still need practice distinguishing a straight line with a corner, such as V, from a smooth curved line. At home, draw a few examples and ask Om to sort them into straight, curved, standing, sleeping, and slanting groups.
